title: Add Ageing Days column to the invoice upload template

requirements.text: Add a downloadable invoice upload template on the Admin "Invoice Management" (Raw Data Upload) page that includes an "Ageing Days" column in the header so users can include it in their working sheet, while keeping the upload parser compatible (Ageing Days must remain optional and ignored during import).

quotes: Yes aging day column need to add in templete so that salesman clearly find overday data first

acceptanceCriteria: On the Admin Invoice Management (Raw Data Upload) page, provide a visible action (e.g., a button/link) to download an invoice upload template file (CSV or tab-separated text is acceptable).
The downloaded template header row includes all existing required columns plus an additional column named exactly "Ageing Days".

Uploading a file that includes the "Ageing Days" column still succeeds as long as the existing required columns are present; the importer ignores the "Ageing Days" values and does not require the column.
The "Required columns" help text on the upload card is updated to clarify that "Ageing Days" is optional and will be auto-calculated in the app.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Do not change the existing Ageing Days calculation logic or the invoices table ageing sort behavior.
Do not add a backend field for Ageing Days or store Ageing Days from uploads; the value remains derived from Invoice Date.
